goal: REAL conveyor belt-motion proof: spawn a real Isaac ConveyorBelt_A09 asset and retrofit the 3-API surface-velocity combo onto its /World/Belt mesh; 3 cubes resting on the belt must RIDE it (advance along +x). No robot (isolates the belt mechanism). First MEGA-direction conveyor build (CP-CONV-01).
thoughts: Belt rides at 1.781m on a tall frame; native height is fine for a no-robot motion proof. The asset belt already has RigidBody+Collision; kinematicEnabled=True + PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI is the retrofit. Verify via scene_eyes per-object x-advance + belt timeline.
code:
# CP-CONV-01: REAL conveyor (ConveyorBelt_A09) belt-MOTION proof. Does the 3-API surface-velocity retrofit
# (robot.py:1880 combo) carry cubes along a real Isaac conveyor asset's belt mesh? NO robot: isolates the belt
# mechanism (pick-off-belt is already proven on generated belts; reach to the 1.781m belt needs a pedestal =
# a separate step). cont.319u, MEGA-direction CP-CONV-01.
create_scene_baseline(include_ground=True, table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

# Real A09 straight conveyor (belt 4.0x0.9m, native ride-height 1.781m on a tall frame). Default prim /World ->
# referenced under /World/Conveyor, so the asset belt /World/Belt maps to /World/Conveyor/Belt. Belt spans local
# x in [-3.969,-0.002] (extends in -x from the asset origin), y in [-0.45,0.45], top-z 1.781.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", prim_type="Xform", position=[0, 0, 0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Conveyors/ConveyorBelt_A09.usd")

# 3-API surface-velocity retrofit on the belt surface. Belt already ships RigidBody+Collision; the CRITICAL bit
# is kinematicEnabled=True (the #1 cause of "belt configured but cubes just sit"). Velocity +x local 0.20 m/s.
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physics:kinematicEnabled", value=True)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocity", value=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityEnabled", value=True)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityLocalSpace", value=True)

# 3 cubes (5cm) resting on the belt surface (z = belt_top 1.781 + half 0.025 + 4mm settle gap). Placed mid-belt
# with belt ahead toward +x. If the retrofit works they ride toward x=0; if it fails they sit (x ~ constant).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-2.0, 0.0, 1.810], scale=[0.025, 0.025, 0.025])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", prim_type="Cube", position=[-2.4, 0.12, 1.810], scale=[0.025, 0.025, 0.025])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", prim_type="Cube", position=[-2.8, -0.12, 1.810], scale=[0.025, 0.025, 0.025])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
verified_note: scene_eyes 40s: all 3 cubes start in contact with /World/Conveyor/Belt and RIDE +x from x=-2.0/-2.4/-2.8 to x=+0.29/+0.17/+0.27 (=+2.3..3.1m, matches 0.2 m/s x ~10-13s). Staggered belt-end arrival (closest cube first @9.8s, furthest last @13.6s) = belt-carry signature. The 3-API surface-velocity retrofit on the REAL conveyor /World/Belt mesh carries objects. The cubes then fall off the UNGUARDED belt end (z 1.78->0.78 onto the table; Cube_1's 62deg topple + the 3.4 m/s are that fall, <8 m/s = not an ejection) -> CP-CONV-02 adds an end-stop / pick-zone.
extension_notes: Belt-motion PROVEN on real assets. CP-CONV-02: (a) end-stop or chute at the belt end (x~0) so cubes arrive at a reachable collection point instead of falling off; (b) pedestal Franka (~1.13m base) to pick off the moving belt at native 1.781m height. Per MEGA_DIRECTION_TRIAGE.md.
